sentences.text:
Coram: N.J.Jamadar, J.
 Date : 15 January 2024

P.C.
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R.No.347 of 2023 registered with Khandeshwar Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 420, 324, 323, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant and the first informant who was 20 years of age, were in a relationship since March 2022.
As the relationship turned astray, and the first informant learnt that the applicant was to get married to another girl, the first informant had lodged a report.
4. Learned APP resisted the prayer for pre-arrest bail, and seeks time to take instructions as the Investigating Officer is not present.
5. I have perused the allegations in the FIR.
Prima facie, it appears that th applicant and the first informant were in a relationship.

The applicant had allegedly made the first informant to believe that they would marry and had forcible intercourse Mayur Prakash Jadhav vs The State Of Maharashtra on 15 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25314982/
1 SSP 1/2  
 with the first informant.

Prima facie,
 appears to be consensual.

Thus, till the application is heard after providin  hearing to the prosecution
, liberty of the applicant deserves to b  7.

Hence, the following order :
 ORDER (i) In the event of the arrest of the Applicant - Mayur Prakash Jadhav in connection with C.R.No.347 of 2023 registered with Khandeshar Police Station, the Applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and report to Khandeshwar Police Station on 22nd and 23rd January 2024 in between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m., and thereafter, as and when directed.
(iii) The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to the first informant or any of the prosecution witnesses or any of the persons acquainted with the facts of the case.
(iv) Stand over to 21 February 2024.
